ragams.name: Bhairavi
ragams.description: A profound and expressive raga often called the queen of ragas. Its rich, grounding phrases sharpen concentration and sustain deep focus.

ragams.name: Neelambari
ragams.description: The quintessential lullaby raga, used for centuries to induce sleep. Its gentle, descending phrases calm the nervous system.

ragams.name: Sahana
ragams.description: A deeply emotive raga of longing and surrender. Its contemplative phrases draw the listener inward, ideal for breathwork and presence.
